en.title: United Airlines opens new Concourse E at Washington Dulles (IAD) Airport
en.summary: United Airlines and the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority opened the new Concourse E at Washington Dulles International Airport on November 10, 2026, the first facility of its type to open there in nearly two decades, with 14 gates in a 435,000-square-foot first stage.
body: United Airlines and the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority opened a new concourse at Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) on November 10, 2026. The brand-new Concourse E is the first facility of this type to open at Washington Dulles in nearly two decades. The opening marks the completion of the first of four construction stages, which will see Concourse E fully replacing the existing Concourse C/D.

The first stage includes a new 435,000-square-foot facility with 14 boarding gates, which will be used by United Airlines. Passengers using the new terminal will also be able to enjoy direct AeroTrain access, new dining and retail options, and a state-of-the-art, 40,000-square-foot United Club lounge, which will offer passengers 70% additional lounge space and is decorated with motifs inspired by the landmarks and sights of the US capital and its surrounding regions. United will see another 36 gates added at a future stage, as well as one of the world's largest Polaris lounges and an expanded customs processing area.

The new Concourse E will also support the carrier's further growth at the airport, including the launch of several new European destinations operated with the carrier's new Airbus A321XLR aircraft, such as Amsterdam (AMS) and Dublin (DUB) in December 2026, and Toulouse (TLS) and Milan (MXP) at a later date. The opening marks an important milestone in an ongoing $20 billion program to modernize Washington Dulles International Airport, jointly backed by the Airports Authority, United Airlines and the US Department of Transportation.

zh.title: 美聯航華盛頓杜勒斯機場（IAD）E航廈啟用，首期設14個登機門
zh.summary: 美聯航與大都會華盛頓機場管理局11月10日在華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場啟用全新E航廈，為該機場近20年來首座啟用的同類設施；首期設施43萬5000平方英尺、14個登機門，未來將再增36個登機門。
body: 美聯航與大都會華盛頓機場管理局11月10日在華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場啟用全新E航廈，為該機場近20年來首座啟用的同類設施。E航廈的啟用是四階段建設計畫的第一階段完成，最終將全面取代現有的C/D航廈。
首期設施43萬5000平方英尺，設14個登機門供美聯航使用，旅客可直接搭乘AeroTrain，並享有新的餐飲與零售選擇，以及4萬平方英尺的全新美聯航貴賓室，貴賓室空間增加70%，裝潢靈感來自美國首都及周邊地區的地標與景致。未來階段將再增加36個登機門，以及全球最大的北極星貴賓室之一與擴大的海關處理區。
E航廈也將支持美聯航在該機場的進一步成長，包括以全新空中巴士A321XLR開闢數條歐洲新航線：阿姆斯特丹與都柏林預定2026年12月開航，土魯斯與米蘭則於較晚日期開航。此次啟用是200億美元杜勒斯機場現代化計畫的重要里程碑，該計畫由機場管理局、美聯航與美國運輸部共同支持。
